headline: Possible Thursday banked reset
scope: Tibo hints at a banked reset on Thursday, November 12.

announcement.text: Thursday is feeling codexy to me. Perhaps also a good time for a banked reset.
announcement.translation: 我觉得周四很有 Codex 的感觉。也许也是来一次储备重置的好时机。

previousAnnouncement.text: It’s been a while without resets. Maybe I should come back out of the basement
previousAnnouncement.translation: 好一阵子没重置了。也许我该从地下室出来了。

note: Tibo’s wording is tentative (Perhaps). Thursday is interpreted as November 12 in this week’s context, without a precise delivery timestamp. No eligibility, expiration or receipt is confirmed.
